{"m": "gpt-4o", "msg": [{"content": "You extract the abstract relational skeleton of a single short anecdote. Focus on the pattern of intentions, causes, concealment, deception, reversals of appearance vs reality, and who is helped or harmed. Abstract away ALL surface details. Every participant or object MUST be labelled with a generic role from a fixed closed set; never use a concrete noun (no names, jobs, policies, companies, conditions, or outcome nouns).", "role": "system"}, {"content": "ANECDOTE:
It's the students' collapsing scores that panic officials into doubling down on the rigid curriculum; that curriculum keeps the test-prep vendors permanently in business, and the district sits on the dropout figures.

Extract its relational skeleton. Respond as JSON with keys:
  "roles": the subset of the CLOSED role set [AGENT, TARGET, THIRD_PARTY, ACTUALITY] that you use,
  "relations": list of [source_role, predicate, target_role] triples,
      where EVERY source_role and target_role is chosen ONLY from [AGENT, TARGET, THIRD_PARTY, ACTUALITY], and predicate ONLY from [intends, causes, prevents, enables, conceals, deceives, manufactures_threat, sacrifices_for, exploits, misattributes_credit, appears_positive, actually_negative, appears_negative, actually_positive, reverses_expectation, tests_loyalty, feigns_inability, protects_by_withholding, harms_by_helping, reveals_hidden_trait],
  "pattern": one abstract sentence describing the deep structure with no surface nouns.
Role rules: the primary actor is AGENT; the person or thing acted upon is TARGET; any additional party is THIRD_PARTY; an abstract state, truth, intention, or outcome that is concealed/intended is ACTUALITY. Do NOT invent any other node label and do NOT use concrete nouns.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "extract_roles"}
